text: Entry Requirements 1. Nationality: Applicants should be non-Chinese citizens . For those who were originally Chinese citizens and later joined the foreign nationality, our school implements No. 12 Announcement of the Ministry of Education of the People’s Republic of China (2020). 2. Age: Applicants must be between 18 and 25 years old and have graduated from high school. Applicants who are still under the age of 18 as of September 1 of the year of enrollment need to submit the original notarial certificate of the guardian issued by the Nanjing District Notary Office, and the guardian must be a permanent resident of Nanjing. Applicants should have good character, good physical and mental health, and be willing to abide by Chinese laws and regulations and the rules and regulations of China Pharmaceutical University. 3. Language ability: Applicants who apply to teach in English must have an English level of IELTS6.5 or TOEFL90 or Duolingo 110 or above . 4. CSCA subjects requirements: ​​
